summary: Possible 5th-great-grandfather of John (father of Julia Ann Watson Scott) - a lead only.
bio:
FamilySearch makes Julia Ann Watson Scott a daughter of George Watson, b. Mansfield, Notts., 6 Apr 1778, in Huntington Twp 1810, Dallas 1820, d. 1830 Fairmount Springs, Luzerne. It pairs him with Ann Nancy Waterman (b. Norwich CT 1780, d. Barrington RI 1809), who had her own Julia Ann Watson b. Bristol RI 17 Jul 1809 - a merge of two families. George Watson of Huntington/Dallas is the only candidate found; the 'Watson from Nottinghamshire' origin is speculative.

The 1820 census attached to George Watson's FamilySearch profile shows a George Watson heading a large family in Dallas Township ([R4-S1]). The columns are too faint to say confidently whether a girl of about 11 (Julia Ann, b. c.1809) was present. The FamilySearch children assigned to him include Jairus Harrison Watson (b. Plymouth 1812, d. New Albany, Bradford Co., 1893), who married Rebecca Van Loon, and Sabina Partington, a widow in Plymouth Twp in 1850 born in Pennsylvania c.1802 ([R4-S2]). Against this identification: no county history mentions a George Watson in Huntington, Dallas or Plymouth, while an Amariah (Amaziah) Watson was a Plymouth taxable in 1796 and settled 'just below the Scott house' on Huntington Creek (Bradsby 1893; see Julia Ann Watson). George's role as Julia's father therefore remains a candidate only, with Amariah Watson an alternative.
